properties.name: Senkaku / Diaoyu / Diaoyutai
properties.bilingual: 尖閣諸島 / 釣魚島 / 釣魚臺
claimants: Republic of China / Taiwan (中華民國)
properties.note: An uninhabited island group in the East China Sea. Japan has administered them since 1972 and considers them part of Okinawa; the People's Republic of China and the Republic of China (Taiwan) both claim them on historical and geographic grounds. Status disputed.

properties.name: Spratly Islands (disputed)
properties.bilingual: 南沙群島 / Quần đảo Trường Sa / Kapuluan ng Kalayaan
properties.note: A disputed archipelago of reefs and islets in the South China Sea, subject to overlapping claims by China and Taiwan (via the nine-dash line), Vietnam, the Philippines, Malaysia and Brunei. Individual features are occupied by different claimants. Status disputed.

properties.name: Paracel Islands (disputed)
properties.bilingual: 西沙群島 / Quần đảo Hoàng Sa / Paracel Islands
properties.note: A disputed island group in the South China Sea, under Chinese de facto control since 1974, also claimed by Vietnam and Taiwan. Status disputed.
